defects.statement: A prior flat in theta transforms to exp(z) dz; the Gaussian posterior in z therefore has mean log_observation+log_sigma^2, not log_observation.
Equal-tail lognormal endpoints do not give the shortest interval in theta; its endpoints must have equal posterior density in theta.

notes: Synthetic study. All displayed numbers reproduce the written release method. Gold corrections are joint, with single interventions audited separately.
